name: Guohua Intelligent
summary: Guohua Intelligent is a robotics manufacturer based in Qingdao, China. It develops and manufactures precision reducers, roller screws, joint modules, robot arms and complete humanoid robot platforms. Its own robot portfolio includes the wheeled Zhishu 2 and the bipedal Yunyi 2. The company also provides configurable robot hardware and ODM development services, covering design, assembly and validation for customers building embodied-intelligence systems.
